newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-ROMARIO CHASED OFF BEACH AFTER ARGUMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO CHASED OFF BEACH AFTER ARGUMENT.

text.p: Brazilian soccer star Romario was chased off a beach after becoming involved in an argument during a foot-volleyball competition, police sources said on Monday.
Romario and his partner began arguing with fans as they were watching another game in the tournament which also involved Vasco da Gama striker Edmundo on Sunday, said an official.
The incident happened in the resort town of Cabo Frio, 120 kilometres east of Rio.
Other people became involved in the discussion and began threatening the former World Cup player, who was forced to flee the beach and was eventually escorted away in a police car.
Media reports quoted one youth as claiming that he had been hit by Romario and said the star had to take refuge in a restaurant before being rescued by police.
Romario rejoined Flamengo on loan from Valencia two months ago after a trouble-ridden 78 days with the Spanish club.

In his first game back he was injured and the next time he played Flamengo were beaten 2-0 by Criciuma and knocked out of the Brazilian championship. He played one more game and has been on holiday since.
Foot-volleyball, which as the name suggests is a version of volleyball in which the hands and arms cannot be used, is a popular beach sport in Brazil and Romario is one of its best-known exponents.
